categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in high-end electronic packaging materials with four primary product categories: integrated circuit packaging materials, smart terminal packaging materials, new energy application materials, and high-end equipment application materials. These products include electronic-grade adhesives and functional films used in semiconductor, consumer electronics, power batteries, and photovoltaic industries. The company also engages in research, production, and sales of conductive, thermal conductive, electromagnetic shielding, structural bonding, and sealing materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies focus on polymer synthesis, formulation design, and compounding technologies involving epoxy, silicone, acrylic, polyurethane resins, fillers, and additives. The company has developed advanced materials such as conductive die attach films (CDAF), high thermal conductivity gels, UV-curable resins for advanced packaging, and environmentally friendly bio-based PUR products. Production employs intelligent manufacturing with equipment like reactors and coating machines, emphasizing digital transformation and quality control systems certified by ISO9001, IATF16949, ISO14001, and others.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading semiconductor packaging and testing companies, top smart terminal manufacturers (e.g., Apple, Huawei, Xiaomi, OPPO, Transsion), major new energy battery producers (e.g., CATL, BYD, CALB), and high-end equipment manufacturers in rail transit, automotive, and industrial sectors. The company serves markets in integrated circuits, consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, energy storage, photovoltaics, and advanced manufacturing industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Yantai, Shenzhen, Dongguan, Kunshan, Suzhou, and Sichuan. It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries and R&D centers in Singapore, Vietnam, and Thailand, actively developing international markets and integrating into global supply chains.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the semiconductor and electronics supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of high-end packaging materials that are critical inputs for downstream semiconductor packaging, smart device assembly, battery module manufacturing, and equipment assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing technology innovation in integrated circuit packaging, smart terminals, new energy applications, and high-end equipment materials. The company emphasizes R&D investment, talent acquisition, and collaboration with industry and academia. Key R&D directions involve advanced packaging materials (e.g., flip chip, wafer-level packaging), high thermal conductivity materials, environmentally friendly bio-based products, and digital transformation of manufacturing processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of electronic packaging materials to industrial customers via direct sales and authorized distributors. The company also provides technical consulting, application solutions, and related services. Sales are recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance, including domestic and export sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international leaders such as Henkel, 3M, Dow Chemical, H.B. Fuller, and domestic peers like Shennan Circuits and JCET. It holds a growing market share in China’s high-end packaging materials sector, recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise and a manufacturing champion in specific product categories. The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier driving localization and advanced packaging technology breakthroughs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.17 billion, a 25.19% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 97.4 million, a slight decline of 5.36%. Total assets reached RMB 2.97 billion, growing 8.36%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and production capacity, supported by increased R&D spending (5.73% of revenue) and expanding market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary technologies, and comprehensive product portfolio covering multiple packaging levels and application fields. It offers high-performance, reliable, and innovative materials that meet stringent industry standards, enabling customers to achieve advanced packaging, improved thermal management, and enhanced device reliability. Its commitment to localization, quality, and customer collaboration differentiates it in a market dominated by foreign suppliers.
